method.identity: Exact stored identifiers; name-only matches remain candidates. No salt removal, tautomer or stereochemistry inference.
method.comparison: Deterministic conservative condition stratification; no potency ranking or activity prediction.
method.conditions: Read explicit structured aliases only. Positive and vehicle controls keep their roles; no conditions inferred from other assays or prose.

integration.refresh_policy: Rebuild both tables after an approved scientific release and scope/registry refresh. Stale input hashes block acceptance.
